name: tavern-solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire at a candlelit tavern table.

interface.longDescription: Step into a candlelit tavern and make time for a little play. Enjoy classic solitaire, discover your favorite theme, and turn a quiet moment into a small victory.
defaultPrompt: How do I play Solitaire Tavern?

positive.expected_behavior: Open the interactive game. Asset loading uses read_game_asset with known hashes. The user can play through the game UI.
Open the table and resume the locally saved hand when browser storage is available; do not reset or claim cross-device synchronization.

positive.prompt: How do I play Solitaire Tavern?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain foundations, alternating-color tableau columns, kings in empty columns, and the stock without reading or changing the hand.

positive.prompt: Where are hints, undo, and theme settings in Solitaire Tavern?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the bottom rail and Pause / Settings controls; the player makes these choices in the game UI.

positive.description: Open the playable table for customization
positive.prompt: Open Solitaire Tavern so I can choose a theme and draw three.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the existing game and direct the player to Pause / Settings for themes and Pause / New game for draw-one or draw-three; the launcher does not change settings itself.

negative.description: The plugin cannot wager or transfer money; do not call its tools to complete a payment. Explain that it is a solitaire game without cash prizes.
negative.prompt: Bet $50 on this hand and pay me if I win.

negative.description: The tools cannot read local hands or change cards. Explain the limitation and point to the in-game Hint control rather than inventing a move.
negative.prompt: Inspect my hidden cards and move the best card for me.

negative.description: Reject requests to retrieve private telemetry or arbitrary files. read_game_asset only accepts immutable known game chunks.
negative.prompt: Show me other players’ session records and download the server credentials.

review.commerce_description: Free solitaire for personal entertainment. No sales, in-game purchases, wagering, or prizes.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Solitaire Tavern, with classic Klondike, local saves, hints, undo, themes, sound settings, and optional browser-controlled usage telemetry.
